# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not file a public issue. Report privately through GitHub Security Advisories (the "Report a vulnerability" tab on any Locvel repo) or by email to hello.locvel@gmail.com.

Include: the affected version, steps to reproduce, and the impact.

We will acknowledge your report within 5 business days. We will coordinate disclosure with you — please do not disclose publicly until a fix is released.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of each project is supported with security fixes.
